original_request: 按照建议完成任务：将 Loop 安全一键接入不同项目
actor: A project maintainer using a supported coding client
scenario: Adopt or upgrade Loop in an existing Git repository without replacing application assets
problem: Bootstrap assumes Loop files already exist and lacks cross-project ownership, reversible upgrades and distributable CLI
desired_outcome: One versioned command installs portable workflow capabilities while preserving project configuration and progress
recommendation: Thin npm launcher + Python lifecycle manager; staged official upstream installers; ownership manifest and guarded journal; GitHub source distribution
in_scope: package whitelist and executable GitHub package
safe merge and local project config
native upstream staging and three client integration tests
out_of_scope: live model evaluation or platform rule activation
constraints: No user skill removal based only on prefix
No automatic execution of discovered business commands

success_metrics.method: Deterministic unit tests plus real packed-package integration

alternatives.tradeoff: Rejected: imports project progress and generic scripts, clobbers files
Rejected as complete solution: omits scripts, config and upstream compatibility
Rejected: unrelated to distribution and adds maintenance

evidence.claim: Bootstrap reads lock and skills from target
npm exec supports running remote package bins

open_questions.question: Public registry publishing identity is not available
open_questions.resolution_plan: Ship verified npm tarball and pinned GitHub package path; do not claim registry publication
